questions.embedding_text: Physics - Waves and Oscillations: The time period of a particle in simple harmonic motion is 8s. At t=0 it is at the mean position. The ratio of the distances travelled by it in the first and second seconds is: Options: 1/2, 1/√2, 1/(√2-1), 1/√3. Correct answer: 1/(√2-1)

question.text: Fresnel diffraction is produced due to light rays falling on a small obstacle. The intensity of light at a point on a screen beyond an obstacle depends on:

options.value: The focal length of lens used for observation
The number of half period zones that superpose at the point
The square of the sum of the number of half period zones

answer.correct_value: The number of half period zones that superpose at the point
